claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ADA to fund 12 months of Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026.
The budget consists of 1,272,777 ADA for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ADA for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The requested work is scoped to compatibility, security, supporting libraries and tooling, release support, and vendor-required audit work, and is not intended to build a new wallet product.
The proposer states that continuous maintenance is needed because Cardano, Ledger, or Trezor changes could otherwise cause users and integrators to lose secure hardware-wallet access.
The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
Treasury funds would be administered through Intersect using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract.

The Oversight Committee is stated to consist of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl, with defined multi-party authorization requirements for key smart-contract actions.

The document discloses prior treasury and Catalyst funding related to hardware wallets, Ledger app work, Plutus enhancement, security, and developer tooling via listed governance and Project Catalyst links.
The proposer states that community auditing and tracking will be available through a Sundae treasury dashboard and on-chain verification.

summary: The anchor document requests 1,310,960 ADA for a 2026 continuity maintenance program for Cardano hardware-wallet support, submitted by Intersect on behalf of a vendor, with budget breakdown, smart-contract custody arrangements, oversight roles, prior-funding disclosures, and references for budget-process and contract-audit verification.
